Cybersecurity incident could have significant cascading and disruptive effects on revenue cycle and services by Optum, AHA says.

Privacy & Security

By Susan Morse,_Executive Editor_| February 23, 2024 | 11:52 AM

Image 2: Optum building

Photo: Courtesy of UnitedHealth Group
